parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the entry in the zone file.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: List of hostnames that are associated with the {{object}}.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Indicates the owner of the {{object}} instance. Note: This parameter was changed to writeOnceReadOnly in the Device:2.18 version.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: Host table entries associated with the device.

parameters.name: LastUpdate
parameters.description: The date and time in UTC when the entry was last changed.

object.description: This object specifies the resource records (RR) of the DNS zone.
